description: This Kotlin source file defines data models and mock data generation for banner items used in the home banner rail of the app. It includes a data class 'BannerItem' representing individual banners and an object 'MockBannerData' that generates mock banner data for development purposes.

classes.name: BannerItem
classes.description: Represents a 4:1 banner card item with an id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: MockBannerData
classes.description: Provides mock data generation methods for banner items to facilitate development and previewing.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a list of mock 'BannerItem' instances with placeholder images, based on the specified count.
